rows.echo-cost-uses-life-total-at-resolution: CR 702.1b: the granted echo {X} is read with X equal to the life total when the trigger resolves, so at 5 life the controller pays {5} or sacrifices the Hellion. Observed: the echo trigger resolved without any payment ask and without tapping a Mountain, and the Hellion stayed; it also stayed when its controller had no lands at all.
